decisions.reason: A quantified customer saving soon after launch is strong positive evidence for a core-adjacent modular concept, so the option value of keeping it is high and the case for abandonment is weak.
As a close-to-core mobile shredder with a dedicated product page in a growing and innovative firm, it is likely to be retained while market uptake continues to resolve.
C has weaker visible traction than A, but as a product built on the established offer in a growing firm the cost of keeping the option open for another year is likely lower than abandoning it now.
The trommel screen is close to the established range and can benefit from existing production and service capabilities, so despite limited evidence it is more likely to be kept than dropped.
